bio: Just yards from Harrods, Harvey Nichols, Sloane Street and Hyde Park The Capital Hotel is a unique townhouse hotel in London's fashionable Knightsbridge with exquisite interiors incorporating acclaimed names in British design, with works of art handpicked or commissioned by the owners.  Mad Hatters Afternoon Tea has been designed using iconic themes from the classic tale Alice in Wonderland by Lewis Carroll. Stripey macarons reflect the Cheshire Cat, and delicate mushroom shapes hide a wonderful taste sensation, all complemented with traditional flavours such as rare roast beef, coronation chicken and cucumber with dill. Please note that we can cater to all dietary requirements.  Afternoon Tea at The Capital Hotel is a firm favourite, whether it is a special treat, a celebration or a relaxing break from shopping at Harrods or Harvey Nichols. We strongly recommended advance booking in order to avoid disappointment.  Afternoon Tea is served from 12pm to 5pm every day.  Please note a 15% discretionary service charge will be charged to the final bill.
